text_block_list.text:
On the day of the "Race Cheering Stream," 
she achieved a magnificent result!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Did you make sure to watch the results? 
Fufu—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I did it, everyoneee!

"The chat floods with 'Congratulations!' 
Seeing that really conveys how moved the 
community members are—"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what should I do... If everyone loves 
me like this, I'll—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I feel like I could go anywhere! ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Well then, as much as we could chat 
forever, that wraps up today's stream.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so, so much for today! —Love 
me♡ Love you♡ Loves Only You signing off♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yup♡ Thanks for all your hard work too, 
Trainer-kun. Managing the stream must've 
been tough, right?

text_block_list.text:
During this race, she was under the 
camera's gaze right until entering the 
waiting room. I thought she might not have 
had a single moment of peace, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all, you know? If anything, it 
felt like we were just chatting in my 
room, so it was really relaxing♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
You gave me strength the entire time. 
Because all of you were right by my side 
today.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Of course there was pressure. But even 
that is just all the love everyone has for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: That's how I was able to run.

text_block_list.text:
Let's do another cheering stream together, 
Trainer-kun. Promise, okay?
